Optional: drop a 2K equirectangular HDRI named sky.hdr here (or gs://<WEB_BUCKET>/env/sky.hdr)
to use it for image-based reflections. Without it the engine bakes reflections from the
physically based SkyMesh atmosphere every few in-game minutes, so lighting follows the
24-hour cycle and the weather.
Free source: Poly Haven (polyhaven.com/hdris).
